pages.text: Wearing the complete soul armor set unlocks additional passive effects:$(br2)Your soul energy will never decay below a certain threshold through natural drain. If it falls below that threshold by other means, it will slowly regenerate back up.$(br2)This means you always have a baseline of power available, even outside of combat.

pages.title: Creepers?
pages.text: When your soul energy is exactly at the minimum threshold and you would receive a lethal blow, $(thing)Soul Rage activates automatically$().$(br2)The fatal damage is reduced to leave you alive, and you immediately enter the empowered state.$(br2)A failsafe against ambushes and surprise explosions, but it only works when your soul energy is sitting at the threshold, so don't count on it mid-fight.
